source_name: EFFIS / Copernicus Fire Weather Index forecast
text: EFFIS Fire Weather Index peaks at 39.2 — 'very high' on the EFFIS scale — at Alcanadre (stage 9) on 2026-10-23, across a 3-day forecast from 2026-10-21. 14 stage endpoint(s) reach 'high' (>= 21.3) or worse: Alcanadre (stage 9) 39, Alfaro (stage 11) 35, Calahorra (stage 10) 34, Logroño (stage 8) 33, Navarrete (stage 7) 31, El Palau d'Anglesola (stage 22) 30. At 'very high' or above: stages [9]. FWI anomaly at Alcanadre is +8.1 versus the seasonal norm. Reported because: changed. Classes: low <11.2, moderate 11.2-21.3, high 21.3-38, very high 38-50, extreme 50-70, very extreme >70.
